scope: Limited manual inspection of the signed bone_2-to-arm experiment against the preserved taper; no game-animation or appearance qualification.
observations: The arm-favoring transfer regresses left shoulder intersections from 131 to 137 at 90 degrees; the right remains 81. All other recorded bend counts remain unchanged and all 16 poses have zero severe-stretch edges.
Selected close and oblique views do not show a useful shape correction. The compressed shoulder transition remains, so this experiment is rejected as a replacement for the taper.

All 517 source-bound contact signatures were verified before editing. Only bone_2, bone_26 and bone_7 weights changed; 140 left and 26 right vertices were modified. Rest geometry, weight normalization and maximum four influences pass the recorded checks.
The diagnostic exports reproduce every stored 45/90-degree count; 68 views rendered without browser errors. These are inspection clips, not qualified game animations.
decision: Do not select this experiment as an improvement. Preserve the tapered parent and test torso-side upper-arm leakage as a separate frozen trial.
